steps.sql: SELECT ERROR_NUMBER() AS n,ERROR_STATE() AS s,ERROR_SEVERITY() AS c,ERROR_LINE() AS l,ERROR_MESSAGE() AS m,ERROR_PROCEDURE() AS p
BEGIN TRY RAISERROR(N'message',16,7); END TRY BEGIN CATCH SELECT ERROR_NUMBER() AS n,ERROR_STATE() AS s,ERROR_SEVERITY() AS c,ERROR_LINE() AS l,ERROR_MESSAGE() AS m,ERROR_PROCEDURE() AS p; END CATCH
WITH c AS (SELECT ERROR_NUMBER() AS n,ERROR_STATE() AS s,ERROR_SEVERITY() AS c,ERROR_LINE() AS l,ERROR_MESSAGE() AS m,ERROR_PROCEDURE() AS p) SELECT * FROM c
SELECT ISNULL(ERROR_MESSAGE(),N'fallback') AS m, COALESCE(ERROR_NUMBER(),0) AS n
